div.ab: Hoc instituerunt Æþelredus rex et sapientes eius apud Badam.

This is the edict which was drawn up by King Æthelred and his councillors at Bath.
King Æthelred and his councilors decreed this at Bath:
Prolog. Dies setzten König Aethelred und seine Witan zu Bath fest.
Prologue. This King Æthelred and his witan established at Bath.
